method: Each distinct underlying fact/event in each company's blind_input record was assigned a stable evidence-event ID (company_slug + short fact label). Every scored dimension whose evidence_used text traces to that fact is listed under it. Measurement only -- no deduplication or penalty applied in this run.

events_cited_by_3_or_more_dimensions.fact: A real, functioning, shipping electric sports car with paying customers who pre-paid deposits.
events_cited_by_3_or_more_dimensions.pillar_weight_concentration: Spread across 3 pillars; no single pillar's scored weight is majority-derived from this one fact alone.
events_cited_by_3_or_more_dimensions.assessment: Closer to LEGITIMATE MULTI-DIMENSIONAL EVIDENCE -- cross-pillar spread limits amplification risk in any one pillar's arithmetic.

events_cited_by_3_or_more_dimensions.fact: Nov-Dec 2008 near-bankruptcy: ~$9M cash, 18% workforce cut, last-minute $40M convertible-debt financing.
events_cited_by_3_or_more_dimensions.pillar_weight_concentration: Burn Efficiency (.25) + Runway (.30) together = .55 of Financial Health's total dimension weight -- MORE THAN HALF of Tesla's Financial Health pillar is driven by this single event.
events_cited_by_3_or_more_dimensions.assessment: CORRELATED EVIDENCE AMPLIFICATION -- within-pillar concentration is severe. This is the single strongest amplification case in the portfolio.

events_cited_by_3_or_more_dimensions.fact: Disclosed merchant count grew from ~20,000 (2010) to over 80,000 (Dec 2013).
events_cited_by_3_or_more_dimensions.pillar_weight_concentration: Customer Growth (.15) + Growth Velocity (.20) = .35, which is 100% of Shopify's scored Traction weight after this run's anchors were applied -- Shopify's ENTIRE Traction pillar score now rests on one fact.
events_cited_by_3_or_more_dimensions.assessment: CORRELATED EVIDENCE AMPLIFICATION, newly introduced by this phase's anchors. Worth flagging explicitly: unlocking Growth Velocity/Customer Growth from the same series that already fed Execution Track Record/Product Execution increases, rather than decreases, this company's single-fact concentration.

events_cited_by_3_or_more_dimensions.fact: Crowdsourced, asset-light model explicitly framed (by the company and press) as structurally avoiding Webvan's owned-fleet failure mode.
events_cited_by_3_or_more_dimensions.pillar_weight_concentration: Operational Execution (.25) + Strategic Execution (.25) = .50, which is two-thirds of Instacart's total scored Execution weight (.75) -- a majority of the Execution pillar traces to one fact.
events_cited_by_3_or_more_dimensions.assessment: CORRELATED EVIDENCE AMPLIFICATION within Execution, though the Market/Product citations are more independently legitimate (different questions: competitive structure vs. present-tense product difference).

events_cited_by_3_or_more_dimensions.fact: Acquisition of a German competitor, strengthening European footprint, shortly before the Series B round.
events_cited_by_3_or_more_dimensions.pillar_weight_concentration: Product Execution (.25) + Strategic Execution (.25) = .50, two-thirds of Airbnb's total scored Execution weight (.75).
events_cited_by_3_or_more_dimensions.assessment: CORRELATED EVIDENCE AMPLIFICATION within Execution -- same pattern as Instacart.

events_cited_by_3_or_more_dimensions.fact: Organic product-usage expansion beyond interface design into whiteboarding, diagramming, presentations.
events_cited_by_3_or_more_dimensions.pillar_weight_concentration: Customer Value (.25) + Adoption Potential (.20) = .45 of Figma's total scored Product weight; Product Execution sits in a separate pillar.
events_cited_by_3_or_more_dimensions.assessment: Mixed -- meaningful within-Product concentration, but genuinely distinct questions (value delivered vs. expansion surface) asked of the same fact, and diluted by a third dimension in a different pillar. Borderline, leaning LEGITIMATE.

events_cited_by_3_or_more_dimensions.fact: Shipped multiple product generations (speakers, then wearables) across the company's history.
events_cited_by_3_or_more_dimensions.pillar_weight_concentration: Technical Capability (.20) + Execution Track Record (.15) = .35 of Jawbone's total scored Team weight (.60) -- over half.
events_cited_by_3_or_more_dimensions.assessment: CORRELATED EVIDENCE AMPLIFICATION -- self-flagged by the original PASS A analyst at the time of scoring; this registry formalizes that flag with an explicit weight calculation. Directly implicated in the Jawbone/Meetup inversion traced in PASS B.

events_cited_by_3_or_more_dimensions.fact: ~85% of income from organizer subscription fees, a real disclosed working monetization model.
events_cited_by_3_or_more_dimensions.pillar_weight_concentration: Spread across 3 pillars, one dimension each -- no pillar's scored weight is majority-derived from this fact alone.
events_cited_by_3_or_more_dimensions.assessment: LEGITIMATE MULTI-DIMENSIONAL EVIDENCE -- the same real fact genuinely and distinctly informs commercial capability, go-to-market functioning, and revenue durability; cross-pillar spread limits amplification.

events_cited_by_2_dimensions.assessment: Modest within-pillar concentration (.50 of Bonobos's scored Execution weight), but two genuinely distinct angles (channel evidence vs. partner-choice evidence).
Legitimate -- pedigree vs. build-capability are distinct questions, commonly evidenced by the same credential fact.

NEW this phase (Anchor Calibration Phase 1 unlocked Unit Economics from the same fact already used for Burn Efficiency). Numerically inert in this run (see Part 9 sensitivity check) but a real double-citation within one pillar -- flagged, not resolved.
Legitimate -- general commercial background vs. specific named leadership credential are distinct, standard angles on an executive-team fact.
Legitimate, and notably the original PASS A analyst deliberately did NOT also cite this fact for Strategic Execution to avoid triple-counting -- good discipline already present.
Legitimate -- overall momentum vs. specific liquidity-position read are distinct questions, cross-pillar.

summary.classification_criterion_used: Cross-pillar spread is the dominant mitigating factor; within-pillar weight concentration exceeding roughly half of that pillar's scored weight is the dominant amplifying factor. This is a measurement criterion applied post hoc for this registry, not a rule enforced anywhere in scoring.
